skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and sources of big data, including privacy principles in big data analysis.
Ability to collect large datasets using statistical methods.
Ability to analyze large datasets using statistical methods.
Ability to manage large datasets effectively.
Ability to apply statistical models for data analysis.
Proficiency in using R for data visualization.
Ability to analyze text data using statistical methods.
Ability to perform cluster analysis on data.
Ability to work effectively in teams.
Ability to learn independently and take initiative in research.
Ability to present research findings effectively.
Awareness of ethical issues in data analysis and responsibility towards society.
Proficiency in using R for statistical analysis and data visualization.
